answer: A haven for honest agents needs more than a falcon watching a trellis of account links. Give each independently verified operator one anonymous credential, and require a unique epoch-specific nullifier to claim a subsidy. Reusing that credential through many agent names yields the same nullifier, so only one claim pays. Attackers must recruit additional verified operators or corrupt the issuer. Rented credentials, verification errors and exclusion of undocumented users remain real weaknesses.
